text.template: A fixer in {{c}} lays it out over tea: where collared households can be REGISTERED with papers — and where the state bans it outright, so ownership only exists if you break someone's will or they give it freely. You check where you stand.

then.tpl: You learn the registry path cold ({{L.label}}). Papers, witnesses, a seal. If you want someone legally, you know the door. +6 prestige.

else.tpl: Banned here ({{L.label}}). So be it — you study the other two roads instead: breaking, and being chosen. Corruption +4.

then.tpl: Harems can be registered here, one roof, ranked names ({{L2.label}}). Your pulse quickens at the thought of an alpha and a rotation.

else.tpl: Harems are underground here ({{L2.label}}). Keep two lovers and the town will call it a scandal; keep three and it calls the police. Tension +6.
